commands.name: line
commands.description: Draw a straight line from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2).

commands.name: circle
commands.description: Draw a circle centered at (cx,cy) with radius r.

commands.name: rect
commands.description: Draw a rectangle outline with top-left (x,y), width w, height h.

commands.name: arc
commands.signature: arc cx cy r startDeg endDeg
commands.description: Draw an arc of circle (cx,cy,r) from startDeg to endDeg (degrees).

commands.name: color
commands.description: Set the stroke color for subsequent shapes. Accepts #rgb or #rrggbb.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the canvas (grid is re-drawn if enabled).
